narration.full_text: Welcome to our journey into linear equations! Today, we'll cover several key objectives. First, we'll understand the general form of linear equations in two variables. Then, we'll learn how to create these equations from real-world word problems. We'll also explore graphical solutions and their interpretations, providing a visual understanding of these systems. Next, we'll master algebraic methods, specifically substitution and elimination, to solve these equations efficiently. We'll identify the conditions that lead to unique, no, or infinitely many solutions, giving you a complete picture of possible outcomes. Finally, we'll apply these powerful concepts to solve various real-world problems, demonstrating their practical importance. Let's dive in!
